## Second comment: IAMTOKKO, 28 Sep 2026, 7:53AM

Read from the user's phone screenshot, relayed by the orchestrator session. Four points: support for
RSE - Shoulder Or Saddle; linking the sit action to chairs ("it sits anywhere, not on the chair");
Observe is still unclear to them in third person, and which mod would make it work; modifier keys
again.

### 1. RSE - Shoulder Or Saddle: it already has its own SkyPrompt prompts

- Nexus 170232, by Hunk92, v1.4 (2026-05-12), 1,074 endorsements. It carries NPCs or corpses on the
  shoulder, loads them onto the horse and shares the mount. It is used through the spell "RSE -
  Shoulder or Saddle" (carry, or load when near the horse) and through dialogue (share a ride).
  Requirements: SKSE, Address Library, OAR, Pandora or Nemesis, SkyUI (MCM); **SkyPrompt is listed
  as an optional requirement.**
- Its changelog confirms native SkyPrompt support. v1.2 (2026-02-03) adds "SkyPrompt compatibility
  (optional)": standing behind an NPC picks them up, and standing behind the horse loads it. v1.3
  (2026-02-05) adds "UI Management for SkyPrompt": the hotkey can be changed in its MCM, with a
  toggle for showing the prompt only when behind an NPC. v1.4 mentions a possible fix for stacked
  frames "caused by the blank mcm and Skyprompt script".
- The prompt is driven by its Papyrus scripts. The public GitHub source (`Hunk92/RSE-Shoulder-Or-Saddle`,
  the three SKSE DLLs) has no prompt or key code. Its **default prompt key is not confirmed**: the
  mod is not in this modlist, and Nexus serves it by manager download only.
- **So CIGAR has nothing to add.** The mod already raises its own prompt, which is exactly what
  CIGAR would do. It is outside CIGAR's scope (`cigar-prompts-replace-mod-hotkeys` covers mods with
  a hotkey problem; this one has already solved it). A key clash with a CIGAR prompt key is the
  player's to settle in RSE's MCM (`cigar-other-mods-keys-are-players-business`). Both prompts can
  be on screen at once only in rare cases, for example standing behind a person long enough for
  주시하기.

### 2. Sitting on chairs: a fact check

- CIGAR's 앉기 is a roleplay pose on the ground or a ledge, anywhere (`src/Rest.*`,
  `docs/019-rest.md`). It is offered after 1 s of looking down, standing still, out of combat and
  **not in furniture**. It never walks to or snaps onto a chair.
- Chairs and benches are the game's own: activate the chair as usual. Once seated, CIGAR offers
  시간 보내기 (hold), and at an inn or a home 마시기 (`docs/019-rest.md` "Pass time in a chair";
  `docs/026-chair-drink.md`). Work stations are excluded.
- The pinned FAQ does not cover this.

### 3. Observe in third person: a fact check

- No extra mod is needed. Since 2.1.1 Observe eases `worldFOV` in both cameras. Third person was
  the camera every test used before 2.1.1, and the 2.1.1 in-game check logged a zoom in both first
  and third person (`docs/031-observe.md`).
- The pinned FAQ (`sticky-faq.txt`) already covers the conditions and the one known blocker: stand
  still for 5 s with the weapon sheathed, looking at a person or distant scenery (never nearby
  objects or furniture); if another mod forces the camera FOV every frame, CIGAR cannot zoom and
  says so once; otherwise post `CIGAR.log`. It does not say "third person" explicitly.
- Their earlier report (2026-09-26) was the pre-2.1.1 first-person bug, or the after-bath case
  still waiting as `TEST-next-ingame.md` N2. Without their `CIGAR.log` there is nothing new.
